record_scope_reconstruction: Ordinary personal passage at Kaplanbek–Navoi/Zangiota during reconstruction, ending with limited passenger restoration in January2025. Technical opening, first observed passenger and prospective full capacity remain distinct.

source_checks.finding: Kazpravda original confirms Kaplanbek closed for reconstruction affecting pedestrians and vehicles.
Kursiv original names Navoi, reconstruction and a first passenger; no general freight restoration inferred.
Official Uzbek roster pairs Zangiata with Kaplanbek and classifies the crossing as automobile.

sites.name: Kaplanbek–Navoi road checkpoint
sites.coordinate_method: Fresh OSM API XML node coordinates
sites.precision: Approximate crossing area, about 100 m; not the historical barrier footprint
sites.evidence_note: Explicit Qaplanbek/Kaplanbek border_control node, paired with Navoi/Zangiata by the official Uzbek checkpoint inventory and reconstruction reports. It is not the similarly named village or Tashkent taxi stand.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Ordinary personal passage at Kaplanbek–Navoi/Zangiota during reconstruction, ending with limited passenger restoration in January2025. Technical opening, first observed passenger and prospective full capacity remain distinct.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: Closed by 6 December 2022; the earlier December 1 announcement is not an observed exact onset. Limited personal passage is supported between the January 27 technical opening and the January 29 report of a first passenger. February 5 full capacity was prospective, and freight restoration is separate. Unknown onset prevents a numeric duration.

independence_statement: Pass B reconstruction from original-source retrievals and coordinate evidence; no pass A files or judgments consulted.
